title: No Rockets
description: Disable Rockets (Disable and Activate if needed)
body:
**No Rockets**

This plugin prevents players from using firework rockets on the server. Firework rockets are commonly used together with Elytra to gain speed or bypass movement limitations. By disabling rockets, movement stays more balanced and predictable, which can be useful for controlled environments, technical servers or specific gameplay rules.

The plugin includes a simple configuration file that allows server administrators to adjust settings and reload the configuration without restarting the server.

**Commands**


```
/norockets
```
Shows the current plugin status and basic usage information.


```
/norockets enable
```
Enables the plugin and blocks the use of firework rockets.


```
/norockets disable
```
Disables the plugin and allows the use of firework rockets again.


```
/norockets toggle
```
Toggles the current state of the plugin.


```
/norockets reload
```
Reloads the plugin configuration.

**Permission**


```
norockets.admin
```

Required to use the commands.
